{{Youmay|Darth Sidious's Sith doctrine|the heretical [[Rule of One]] doctrine used by the [[One Sith]]}}
[[File:Emperorreborn.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] who viewed himself as the pinnacle of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].]]

The '''Rule of One''' was a self-affirming doctrine conceived by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to replace the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], a long-standing [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] doctrine he considered to be outmoded, it having fulfilled its purpose by placing him in power.<ref name="BoSSftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

The Rule of One was first articulated in Darth Sidious's political treatise ''[[Absolute Power]]'', where in he stated that the Sith would be embodied by a sole reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]&mdash;Sidious himself&mdash;who would live forever as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], having no need to train a replacement, and availing himself solely of capable executors of his will, talented in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] agents. These agents learned a smattering of Sidious's abilities, but did not assume even a fraction of his authority.<ref name="BoSSftDS" />

[[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane's]] [[Order of the Sith Lords|Order]] prior to Darth Sidious, calculated that the rise of "One Sith," a Dark Lord so powerful he would have no need of replacement, was inevitable.<ref name="The Tenebrous Way">{{InsiderCite|130|The Tenebrous Way}}</ref>
